How To Use The Seated Row Machine
candidates.description:
Learn how to set up and use the seated row machine in this video demonstration.

The seated row is an exercise which works the muscles in your back. The seated row machine is a fixed resistance machine which allows you to perform this exercise using a pre-determined movement pattern. This makes it easier for beginners and helps to prevent injury. 

You can read more about the benefits of fixed resistance machines here: https://www.puregym.com/blog/5-resistance-machines-gym-beginners-need-to-try
